# MindCheck Tools

> Browser-based screening instruments, self-reflection tools, calculators, and guided exercises.
> Some screening pages implement published validated instruments; other tools are educational or self-reflection resources. None provides a diagnosis or medical advice.

All interactive answers and scores are processed locally in the browser. Sensitive tool routes do not load analytics or advertising. Optional services on eligible public pages require consent. No account is required to use the tools.

## Start here

- [Screening and tool directory](https://mindchecktools.com/screening-tools)
- [Clinical evidence](https://mindchecktools.com/clinical-evidence)
- [Methodology](https://mindchecktools.com/methodology)
- [How to talk to your doctor about mental health](https://mindchecktools.com/how-to-talk-to-your-doctor-about-mental-health)
- [Crisis resources](https://mindchecktools.com/crisis-resources)

## Published screening and research instruments

These are educational self-screens or research measures, not diagnostic services.

- [PHQ-9 depression self-check](https://mindchecktools.com/phq-9-depression-test)
